title: TSP #133 - Keysight UXR 110GHz BW, 256GS/s, 10-bit Real-Time Oscilloscope Teardown & Experiments
summary: Shahriar of The Signal Path tears down and experiments with Keysight's UXR real-time oscilloscope, which offers 110GHz bandwidth and 256GS/s sampling, and compares architectures from Keysight, LeCroy and Tektronix.
why: Recommended as part of a channel with deep teardowns of extreme test equipment, valuable for anyone interested in electronics or RF.

quote.text: If you even have a passing interest in electronics or radio, I can't recommend his channel enough.
